n05c3fe3b31.headline: Telecom Italia: CDP to enter capital
n05c3fe3b31.summary: Italy's public financial institution Cassa Depositi e Prestiti (CDP) plans to take a stake of up to 5% in Telecom Italia to protect state interests in the former telephone monopoly.
n05c3fe3b31.why: Telecom Italia is Italy's largest telecom operator. State involvement aims to safeguard national strategic interests in telecommunications infrastructure and services.

impacts.name: Telecom Italia
impacts.why: State fund investment may stabilize Telecom Italia's ownership and support strategic initiatives.

nced34d1920.headline: Customs officers seized 22 tons of moldy cocoa beans - Novinky
nced34d1920.summary: Customs officers detained nearly 22 tons of moldy cocoa beans from Nicaragua, requiring the importer to remove the goods from the EU or face destruction.
nced34d1920.why: Food safety enforcement affects commodity trade flows and supply chains in the cocoa market, impacting importers and downstream processors.
